facts.text: It's all over my head, not in one spot.
The nausea has been getting worse and worse.

facts.item: how long the headache, nausea and vomiting have lasted
facts.text: All of this has been going on for two months.
I've lived in California for eight years.

findings.name: neurological examination
findings.result: Normal apart from the mild neck stiffness.

findings.name: white blood cell count with differential
findings.result: White blood cell count 6500/mm3 (75% neutrophils, 15% lymphocytes, 8% monocytes).

findings.name: metabolic panel
findings.result: Serum glucose 90 mg/dL; electrolytes normal; renal function normal.

findings.name: noncontrast head CT
findings.result: Dilated lateral and third ventricles consistent with hydrocephalus.

findings.name: lumbar puncture with CSF analysis
findings.result: Opening pressure 400 mmHg; 330 white blood cells/mm3 (14% neutrophils, 45% lymphocytes, 38% monocytes, 3% eosinophils); protein 84 mg/dL; glucose 43 mg/dL; 3 red blood cells/mm3.

findings.name: CSF cultures
findings.result: Bacterial, viral, fungal, and mycobacterial cultures negative.

findings.name: MRI of the brain
findings.result: Hydrocephalus with dilation of the lateral and third ventricles, stenosis of the cerebral aqueduct, absence of meningeal enhancement, and a subtle cystic area in the region of the aqueduct.

gold.reasoning: 1. Bacterial meningitis was excluded — “A Gram stain … of CSF were negative and final … bacterial … cultures were negative.” 2. Viral meningitis was excluded — “final … viral … cultures were negative.” 3. Fungal meningitis was excluded — “final … fungal … cultures were negative.” 4. Mycobacterial meningitis was excluded — “final … mycobacterial cultures were negative.”

x009: Opening pressure is given as 400 mmHg in the source, which is implausible; probably 400 mmH2O. Kept as written.
x012: The sentence does not say 'CSF' for the cultures; they follow the CSF stains and are read as CSF cultures.
x013: The MRI is reported after the start of empiric therapy; the exact day is not given, so time is 'later in the workup'.

source_issues: CSF opening pressure 400 mmHg is implausible as written (probably mmH2O).
notes: Index visit: the outpatient presentation with two months of diffuse headache, progressive nausea and vomiting (s001–s004), with the workup that followed (s005–s007, s009).
Neck stiffness is kept as an examination finding only: the prompt reports it from the examination ('mild'), not as a complaint, so no patient fact claims the patient noticed it.
The general statement 'neurologic examination otherwise normal' is one record with the usual neurological components as aliases, because the prompt gives no component separately.

excluded_sentences.reason: Treatment (empiric antimycobacterial therapy) for a presumed diagnosis: clinician reasoning and treatment, not a finding.
